Bring more to life.   

 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? 

 At Phenomenex, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. 

 You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. 

 Phenomenex isn’t your typical scientific company. Founded nearly 40 years ago, Phenomenex is a global technology leader committed to developing novel analytical chemistry solutions that solve the separation and purification challenges of researchers, advancing the future of scientific analysis and investigation, ensuring the quality of essentials like your food, water, shampoo, and even cold medication. Be part of our global success and together, we accelerate the discovery, development and delivery of solutions that safeguard and improve human health. 

 Learn about the Danaher Business Syste m which makes everything possible.   

 As part of the Global IT Infrastructure team, this position partners with regional IT teams, cybersecurity, and business stakeholders to deliver infrastructure modernization, operational excellence, and technology standardization initiatives across Phenomenex and Danaher operating companies.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, deploy, and support enterprise networking solutions including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, routing, switching, VPN, Internet, and remote access services. Deploy and support Azure networking technologies including Virtual Networks (VNets), VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, Load Balancers, and hybrid connectivity.
 Provide Level 3/4 support for complex network and infrastructure incidents and service requests and lead infrastructure, cloud, and network migration projects.
 Monitor and optimize performance, availability, capacity, and security of network and infrastructure services.
 Support disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resiliency programs while developing and maintaining technical documentation, standards, and architecture diagrams.
 Collaborate with global IT teams to support strategic technology initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise network and infrastructure environments. Experience with Cisco networking technologies including SD-WAN, routing, switching, and wireless networking.
 Experience supporting Azure networking and hybrid cloud infrastructure and experience with Palo Alto firewall administration and network security controls.
 Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN technologies, and network troubleshooting.
 Strong communication, project management, and customer service skills and the ability to work independently within a global team environment.
 
 Phenomenex, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info .

 The annual range for this role is $100,000 to $105,000 per year . This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future. 

 This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.  

 We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. 

 Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.
